## Project: MedExplain AI Healthcare Platform
### Tech Stack:
- Frontend: React.js
- Backend: FastAPI
- Database: MySQL (root/passw0rd, medical_ai database)
- Features: Medical report upload, multi-language support, patient history, health recommendations, authentication

### Development Guidelines:
- Use modern React hooks and functional components
- Implement JWT authentication
- Follow REST API best practices for FastAPI
- Use SQLAlchemy for database ORM
- Implement proper error handling and validation
